title: State World Models: Execute the Rules, Generate the Pixels
author: Chan Yan Ki, Yanran Zhang, Wenzhao Zheng, Xiaofeng Wang et al.
description: Existing world models can generate action-conditioned video from a single image. Many focus on camera movement, allowing users to explore the generated scene. summary: Existing world models can generate action-conditioned video from a single image. Many focus on camera movement, allowing users to explore the generated scene.
takeaways: To evaluate rule compliance, we build WorldState-Bench, a benchmark of 50 counterfactual twin pairs that share an initial frame and action but differ in hidden state and required outcome.
Under rule-only prompting, the best of the 11 evaluated video backends produces the required endings for both cases in 32% of pairs.
Many focus on camera movement, allowing users to explore the generated scene.
